title: Detailed telescope
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Tripod legs -->
  <rect x='44' y='55' width='4' height='35' rx='2' fill='#8B5E3C'/>
  <rect x='52' y='55' width='4' height='35' rx='2' fill='#A0704A'/>
  <rect x='48' y='78' width='4' height='18' rx='2' fill='#C08050' transform='rotate(-25 50 87)'/>
  <rect x='48' y='78' width='4' height='18' rx='2' fill='#D09060' transform='rotate(25 50 87)'/>
  <!-- Tripod feet -->
  <rect x='42' y='88' width='8' height='4' rx='2' fill='#6B4226'/>
  <rect x='50' y='88' width='8' height='4' rx='2' fill='#7B5236'/>
  <rect x='61' y='88' width='8' height='4' rx='2' fill='#6B4226' transform='rotate(25 65 90)'/>
  <rect x='31' y='88' width='8' height='4' rx='2' fill='#6B4226' transform='rotate(-25 35 90)'/>
  <!-- Main tube -->
  <rect x='22' y='30' width='56' height='16' rx='8' fill='#4A90D9'/>
  <rect x='22' y='32' width='56' height='5' rx='3' fill='#6AAEE8'/>
  <!-- Tube highlight -->
  <rect x='26' y='33' width='48' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#9CC8F0'/>
  <!-- Front lens hood -->
  <rect x='16' y='27' width='10' height='22' rx='4' fill='#3A70B0'/>
  <rect x='16' y='29' width='10' height='6' rx='3' fill='#5A90D0'/>
  <!-- Lens -->
  <ellipse cx='19' cy='38' rx='3' ry='7' fill='#2A5090'/>
  <ellipse cx='19' cy='38' rx='2' ry='5' fill='#4A80C0'/>
  <ellipse cx='18.5' cy='36' rx='1' ry='2' fill='#A0D0FF'/>
  <!-- Back eyepiece -->
  <rect x='76' y='32' width='10' height='12' rx='4' fill='#3A70B0'/>
  <rect x='82' y='34' width='6' height='8' rx='3' fill='#2A5090'/>
  <ellipse cx='88' cy='38' rx='2' ry='3' fill='#5A90D0'/>
  <!-- Focus knob -->
  <rect x='58' y='44' width='8' height='8' rx='3' fill='#D97040'/>
  <rect x='60' y='46' width='4' height='4' rx='2' fill='#F0A060'/>
  <!-- Finder scope -->
  <rect x='48' y='20' width='22' height='6' rx='3' fill='#E8A040'/>
  <rect x='48' y='21' width='22' height='2' rx='1' fill='#F0C870'/>
  <rect x='46' y='19' width='4' height='8' rx='2' fill='#C08030'/>
  <rect x='68' y='19' width='4' height='8' rx='2' fill='#C08030'/>
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='23' rx='1.5' ry='3' fill='#FFD080'/>
  <!-- Finder mount -->
  <rect x='52' y='26' width='3' height='4' rx='1' fill='#B07020'/>
  <rect x='62' y='26' width='3' height='4' rx='1' fill='#B07020'/>
  <!-- Decorative bands -->
  <rect x='38' y='28' width='3' height='20' rx='1.5' fill='#7AB8E8'/>
  <rect x='60' y='28' width='3' height='20' rx='1.5' fill='#7AB8E8'/>
  <!-- Tripod hub -->
  <rect x='46' y='52' width='8' height='6' rx='2' fill='#C08050'/>
  <!-- Small star on lens -->
  <circle cx='22' cy='30' r='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='28' r='0.8' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- Reflection dots -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='34' r='1' fill='#C0E0FF'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='34' r='1' fill='#C0E0FF'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='32' r='0.8' fill='#C0E0FF'/>
</svg>
